input.summary: Add 30 days' written notice, business-hours limitation and confidentiality obligation on the auditor
input.comment: [Playbook] We added thirty (30) days' prior written notice, confined inspections to our normal business hours, and required the auditor to be bound by confidentiality, consistent with our audit playbook position; the existing annual frequency and Commerce One cost-bearing (subject to the 5% underpayment threshold) are acceptable as drafted.

ops.oldText: Such inspections may be made no more than once each calendar year, at reasonable times and upon reasonable notice.
ops.newText: Such inspections may be made no more than once each calendar year, during Corio's normal business hours and upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice, and shall be conducted off-site wherever practicable and without access to Corio's systems or networks. Prior to any such inspection, the accountant shall execute a written confidentiality agreement with Corio no less protective of Corio's Confidential Information than Section 10 of this Agreement.
